name: Connecting Ridge
why: One of NASA's 13 candidate Artemis III regions of 2022 ('Connecting Ridge'); not among the nine kept in 2024. NASA Goddard's lighting study of the 5 m models found it has the most area lit more than 70 % of the time.
position_note: The centre is the centre of the grid of the NASA 5 m terrain model. The USGS box of the region has the same corners as the model.
